title: The perfect physique I
author: DerzarWillz DerzarWay
desc: Program for novice and intermediate lifters. It's an  intense training program with supersets. Each set should only have 30 seconds to 1 min rest MAX, then start doing your next sets.. Has an optional strength day and ab workout routine

ss.note: SUPERSET ONE:  WITH EACH SET 1 MIN REST
SUPERSET TWO:  WITH EACH SET 1 MIN REST
SUPERSET THREE:  WITH EACH SET 1 MIN REST FOCUSING ON ISOLATION/CONTRACTION

ex.note: ISOLATION MOVEMENTS
Increase weight with each set

ss.note: Tri-set workout wide grip upright row to target side delts lift bar inline with nipples  then back down move to partial raises controlled then full motion side lat raises
Heavy weight partials
Light weight full range of motion
Supersets with the seat at a 45 or 30-degree angle soon as you finish front raises start doing lying seated rear laterals both control movements
Seated face pulls

ex.note: Full range of motion get a good stretch at the top movement it's a high rep so lightweight if you feel the burn that's your sweet spot keep that weight , increase when need be
Finisher light weight again finish off those side delts there's many differentiation with side delts you choose what's best for you
Descending rep range start light increase weight with each set
The finisher Keep it light with Constant tension variation
This is a warm-up light weight to activate back , angle seat at 45 or 30 degrees. Lying facedown Protract shoulders first/ like your trying to touch your shoulders together before lateral raise
Low Close grip

ss.note: Seating down facepulls
Seated zottoman curls

ex.note: Light weight controlled and slow negative with    one and a half quarter squat  then full squat thats one Rep
Higher and wide foot placement Heavy weight
